brief_summary: 2 weeks screening period, 4 weeks run-in period, 24 weeks double-blind treatment period, to evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Retagliptin Plus Henagliflozein added to Metformin compared to Retagliptin or Henagliflozein in combination with Metformin in Subjects with Type 2 Diabetes who have Inadequate Glycemic Control on Metformin Alone
brief_title: Dual Add-on Therapy in Type 2 Diabetes Poorly Controlled With Metformin Monotherapy
official_title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Parallel Group, Phase 3 Trial to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Retagliptin Plus Henagliflozein Added to Metformin Compared to Retagliptin or Henagliflozein in Combination With Metformin in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes Who Have Inadequate Glycemic Control on Metformin Alone

primary_outcomes.measure: Mean change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 24
